latin: Maior pars rerum quae in somnis innotescunt aut per purgationem animae, aut per indemoniationem, aut per meram spiritus reuelationem innotescunt.
translation: The greater part of the things that become known in dreams become known either through purification of the soul, or through possession by a demon, or through a pure revelation of the spirit.
